insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address of an unfulfilled order is updated. This change affects the GraphQL Admin API and applies to orders updated through this mutation as of August 31, 2026. Previously, taxes were not recalculated when the shipping address was changed.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the GraphQL Admin API, particularly those working with order updates, should be aware of this change. It may require adjustments in how tax calculations are handled in their applications, especially if they are using the orderUpdate mutation. This change could impact the accuracy of tax calculations for orders with updated shipping addresses. Developers should review their code to ensure compatibility with this update and consider testing their applications to verify that taxes are correctly recalculated.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations for orders when the shipping address is updated, which can affect their financial records and customer invoices. This change enhances the accuracy of tax calculations, potentially reducing errors and discrepancies.
insight.why_it_matters: This update matters because it improves the accuracy of tax calculations for orders, which is crucial for both merchants and developers. It ensures that tax amounts are correctly recalculated when order details change, maintaining the integrity of financial transactions and records.

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.3 patch changes improve local debugger connections. Additionally, @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.1 improves reliability of local debugger connections.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API and Shopify Functions
themes.detail: New fields are available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. Shopify Functions API version 2026-10 adds a createdAt field to the Customer object, and updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes as of August 31, 2026.

themes.title: POS and Storefront Updates
themes.detail: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API, and the shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement for customer accounts, supporting passwordless sign-in and automatic sign-in with trusted devices.
